display.title: Fighting the Yetzer Hara: Three Secret Weapons
display.summary_short: Why the Torah was given to people and not to angels, and how a soldier in Hashem's army beats the sly yetzer hara with Torah, davening and tzedakah.
display.summary_long: A talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show, from the week before Purim. Uncle Yossi recalls that when Hashem was about to give the Torah, the angels asked that it stay in Heaven, and Hashem answered that angels have no yetzer hara, so commands like 'do not steal' are not for them. People have both a good soul and a yetzer hara, a sly enemy who disguises himself to trick us into sinning. Like an alert soldier, we must recognize him right away, never argue with him and simply ignore him, and Hashem will make him weaker and weaker. Uncle Yossi then shares three 'top secret weapons': learning more Torah each day, davening with all our heart, and giving tzedakah every day, with extra coins in the pushka before Shabbos candle-lighting on Friday. Doing our best this way hastens the coming of Moshiach.
display.lesson: Don't argue with the yetzer hara; ignore him, and weaken him with Torah, davening and daily tzedakah.
